text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Phew, today's bath felt so good too~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The flowers on display were so pretty too~. Bouquet-chan's the one who changes them, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If it put you at ease, then nothing could make me happier.
I always feel a bit sheepish... being the one to pick, though.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, thank you! Thanks to you,
I can soak in the bath while gazing at beautiful flowers...
It's truly the privilege of the Miho Dorm residents.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew!
And that fragrance was simply wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Those flowers are gardenias, right?
They smell so sweet during the rainy season!
They're a perfect match for a humid bathhouse!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I thoroughly enjoyed my bath wrapped in such a sweet scent! Thank you, as always!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâyou saw right through me, didn't you?
...As expected of you, Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Just like that... Ai-san always
understands the meaning behind the flowers
I arrange in the bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Picking them out gradually became quite fun.
............

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's only natural to wonder about its meaning.
...You put your heart into it so that everyone's minds find peace, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what feelings you pour into it, Bouquet-chan,
I promise I'll understand them. Looking forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Next time—
perhaps I should put a little more heart into it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Today's Bath Day was a huge success too!
The citrus bath salts worked wonders—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"And the flowers Bouquet-chan prepared were prairie gentians,
which have a very faint scent. You were thoughtful enough to ensure
they wouldn't clash with the bath salts, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...However—the truth is, I infused it with a slightly more intricate meaning this time.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh.
Then what other meaning does it have?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a second!
Don't answer yet!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You went through all the trouble of picking this for me, and I can't even read what it means...!
I refuse to accept this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Ai sure is persistent.
Why not just ask for a hint, then?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh— Alright, fine... just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Um... In the language of flowers, the prairie gentian means
gratitude, grace, and hope...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...You want me to enjoy the graceful colors of flowers... is that it...?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, that's part of it...
but I also tied it into what's been happening around the dorms lately."

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Recent events at the dorm? What could it be...?"
"Special curry will be served in the cafeteria this weekend...
Does that mean... keep hope alive...!?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Mmm…… Maybe it's a bit different……?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Why has this turned into a quiz show...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Well then, if I may...
make the announcement—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kh--... Ah!?
I got it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, we found homes for all the rescue kittens staying at the dorm...!
So that's "gratitude"!
And "hope" for the kittens' future, right?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is my final answer...!
...Well, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Magnificent.
That is—correct."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I... I did it!! Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. ...To tell the truth,
there was actually another meaning to it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I thought it would be tactless to say anything to Ai-san when she was so happy, so... I decided to keep it to myself.
choice_data_list: The Miho Dorm... doesn't sound boring at all.
The Miho Dorm... doesn't sound boring at all, does it?

text_block_list.text: I thought it would be tactless to say anything to Ai-san when she was so happy, so... I decided to keep it to myself.

The Miho Dorm... doesn't sound boring at all, does it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. All sorts of people gather here in harmony—it's a wonderful dormitory.
choice_data_list: (...She sure knows how to wrap things up nicely...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, having people around who try
to understand Curren Bouquetd'or's thoughtfulness
was truly the best thing of all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. It's for the person who
always considers my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I intend to tell them... again, someday.
This time, with words.
